answer: A single lab badge used to unlock every shale-core locker on level C. To bind a badge now, the holder posts an 18,250-unit bond for 33 hours and must walk 740 meters of wet drift with a sealed lantern whose filament draws 2.15 W. At station 12-D the lantern is opened for 8.0 seconds over a 0.62-gram ember cup; four sidewall spectrometers have to agree on the 589.3 nm sodium line to 0.08 nm, and the bond receipt is signed only after that 4-way match. Two mismatches, or a second attempt within 28 hours, slash 53 percent of the bond and freeze locker row C-12 for 15 days.
